dateAssessment:
Working campaign calendar: YAML September 18–October 6, 1749, with October 6 explicitly tentative. The current transcript establishes the post-battle day (t01), a completed Aurbez rest (t02), and the Isingue stay ending in early October (t03); it does not independently confirm either day number. The initial couple of days and week or two of Ranger arrivals sit within the overall couple-week restoration montage.

The opening encounter (t04 / s004 / c001, DF138 u0317–u4168) carries an inferred morning watch on the working September 18 date. Supplementary DF137 establishes morning after the camp rest at u3552–u3558 and repeats the morning reference during the river approach at u3698–u3773, especially u3766. Its ensuing river fight ends at u5491–u5509; the party heals, follows the tendril and rushes straight to the plaza at u5561–u5746, where the next encounter is set up at u5790–u5818. DF138 u0012–u0072 resumes that confrontation and u0535–u0537 confirms no intervening rest. The hour at DF137 u5565–u5567/u5605 concerns the leviathan spell’s duration, and the clock/sunset discussion at DF137 u3672–u3692/u5814–u5818 concerns real-world dinner plans; none establishes a later adventure watch. This supplementary carry supplies no exact clock.

The later post-battle day, Aurbez rest and restoration montage retain open watches; their timing does not establish that the morning watch continues through them. The passenger flights and possible mirror examinations at u4323–u4324 lie within the closing montage; they supply no exact extra days or completed examinations.

watches.summary: Opening encounter carries DF137’s morning through the immediate plaza approach; DF138 confirms no intervening rest.
Over the course of the post-battle day, the party teleports to Aurbez; no watch is stated.
Accepted long rest restores spell slots: eight hours by convention; neither waking watch nor overnight transition is stated.

watches.day: After the Aurbez rest → early October 1749
watches.summary: Couple-week Isingue stay ends in early October; initial settling and Ranger arrivals belong within that montage.
